services.desc: Want the ease of walking down the dock and boarding your boat already on the water? We offer slips and buoys to your store your boat at this season! Check out our rates here. Take your family out on our Moomba Mobius and wakeboard the day away! The Moomba Mobius holds 16 making sure you don’t leave any of the family out of the fun. You can surf, wakeboard, ski, pull a tube, fish, just about anything with the Mobius. Check it out in our Photo

blurb: Looking to rent a Pontoon for the friends and family to explore Colorado’s second largest lake? We’ve got you covered! Head to Doc’s Marina for all your boating and off-road desires. At the marina, we offer Wakeboard/Surf/Ski Boats, Pontoons, Fishing Boats, Kayaks, Stand-up Paddleboards, and more! Looking for some off-road vehicle to explore the mountains this weekend? Doc’s Marina offers Polaris RZR UTV’s for rent.
